name: SPACE MARINES: INTERCESSOR SQUAD
description:
Intercessors are tough, flexible, highly skilled, and capable of laying down withering hails of fire. Bolt rifles booming, Intercessors serve as the mainstay of the Chapter's battle line, and are equally effective whether advancing to seize vital strategic positions from the foe or digging in to hold ground already claimed.

Hold the Line, and Break Theirs

This multipart plastic kit builds a squad of 10 Intercessors, the core of any Space Marines army for your games of Warhammer 40,000. These versatile warriors combine the resilience and endurance of power armour with the high rate of fire and destructive potential of the iconic bolt rifles they carry. Capable of a variety of battlefield roles, every strike force will benefit from the inclusion of these shock troops.

Customise Your Unit

The Intercessor Squad is easy to customise. The Sergeant's right arm can hold a bolt rifle, plasma pistol, or bolt pistol with a bolt rifle slung over the shoulder, while the left arm can be equipped with a chainsword, power sword, or power fist. You'll also find 2 optional tilting shields, 2 unique helmeted heads, and 3 optional backpack toppers, including a back banner, along with either an empty holster or a holstered pistol. 2 Intercessors can take an underslung grenade launcher. This versatile kit also includes many interchangeable parts so no two units need look alike.

Interchangeable parts:
– 13 helmeted heads
– 6 bare heads
– 24 shoulder pads
– 10 sets of greaves
– 8 sets of arms holding bolt rifles
– 4 left arms (pointing, holding an auspex, holding a knife, and holding a grenade)
– 3 right arms with bolt rifles
– 9 backpacks
– 5 belt-mounted accessories
– 5 purity seals
– 1 half helmet

Contents:
– 154 plastic components
– 10 Citadel 32mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet

The Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet features 664 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors, as well as unit designations, numbers, honour markings, and campaign badges to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
